The '''Rodian Hunters' Camp''' was a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] camp established by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Among the beings that stayed at this camp in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] were the Rodians [[Kerssoc]] and [[Ortha Ledox]] as well as a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] working for [[Wookiee Trading Co.]].
